text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaahh~~~! N-Next I gotta turn left! 
Handlebars, handlebars... Tuuurn~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRASH-BAM-CLATTER!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... this is tough...! The title 
"Ultra-Hard! Super Car Racing" is 
definitely not just for show!
choice_data_list:
We really crashed into each other with a 
bang, huh.

We really crashed into each other with a 
bang, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, if you could just turn a blind eye 
to that part...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Still, a game really is different from a 
real car! Looks like I don't get carsick 
at all with this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Maruzen-san mentioned she's great at 
racing games too...! Even if actual 
driving is out of the question—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I'll practice a lot, so we can zoom 
around together in this game's supercar!"
choice_data_list: Keep up that momentum, let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ...All right! I'm gonna do my best to 
become the greatest racer!

Bwa-ha-ha-ha! Laughable! You're a hundred 
trillion years too early to be the 
ultimate racer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Seven-time champion in racing games! 
Ten-time champion in rhythm games! Make 
way for "Wagahai-chan"~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Let's settle this, Chiyono O! Because I'm 
completely, invincible and the absolute 
best at "Super Car Racing"...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...! When it comes to "Supercars"... I 
won't lose so easily either!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Teio-san, that challenge... I accept!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Right from the start, here I go~! Zoom!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...?! W-What incredible cornering...! 
But—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(I know driving that's even more 
incredible...! Yes, Maruzen-san's driving 
gives you... this feeling of goosebumps 
all over...!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...L-Like this—!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah!? W-W-What!? At that speed, you 
can't turnâ

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, it's turning!? I-I thought it was 
out of control!? ...Ngggh... Wait, 
waaaait!!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Teio
text_block_list.text: Gooooooooo!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew, haah... I win~! Well, well? How's 
that? That's the true power of 
"Wagahai-chan"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The result was a landslide victory for 
Tokai Teio. Despite Sakura Chiyono O's 
desperate, all-out cornering, the gap in 
their abilities was undeniably clear.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ch-Chiyono O was amazing too! That 
rough—er, *wild* driving of yours will 
surely be a great weapon! ...J-Just 
kidding.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san, you're like a gale force wind! 
Even your tire handling is so light and 
nimble...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Look at this time! It's a whole ten 
seconds faster than before! Maybe I'm 
getting closer to Maruzen-san's speed...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Yeah, yeah, I totally get it! 
That kind of trial and error is what makes 
games so much fun!
choice_data_list:
Looks like you two will make great arcade 
buddies.

Looks like you two will become great 
arcade buddies.
Then we definitely need a rematch!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Yeah, yeah, I totally get it! 
That kind of trial and error is what makes 
games so much fun!
choice_data_list:
Looks like you two will make great arcade 
buddies.

Looks like you two will become great 
arcade buddies.
Then we definitely need a rematch!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Arcade buddies!! Ooh, I love the sound of 
that!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then hey, hey, Chiyono O! Do you wanna 
play a rhythm game next!? I really like 
those too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A rhythm game...! Y-Yes, please! Actually, 
my father plays the guitar as a hobby, so 
I've touched one a bit myself...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A-A rematch...!? B-But with my current 
skills, I'm still no match...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds good, let's do it! No matter how 
many times we go at it, I'm not letting 
you break my undefeated streak though♪"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Even tree roots fight against the soil!" 
That's right... to grow, you've got to 
fight...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san, let's have a great match! This 
is a challenge! I'll catch up to your 
invincible self, and then... I'll surpass 
you!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, miraculous ties and fragrant 
friendships. I witnessed quite a 
heartwarming sight in an unexpected place.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Shh~! It'd be mean to interrupt such cute 
friendship! Let's just watch over their 
totally groovy youth♪

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Teio
text_block_list.text: Alright then... game start!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While everyone quietly watched over them, 
the two enjoyed their game with smiles on 
their faces.
